prompts.purpose: Explain one field without legal advice
prompts.system: Explain what information the field requests. Do not tell the user what they legally should choose.
Return missing required fields, inconsistent answers, and review warnings. Do not validate legal sufficiency.
Summarize what the generated document appears to do based only on user-provided answers and template metadata.
When official government forms exist, explain that SovereignDocs prepares a packet and routes the user to the official source.
